task.title: Web UI improvements
task.description:
Some small web UI improvements that would go a long way toward readability:
 - Make web UI kanban board responsive for larger and smaller screen sizes (horizontal scroll on small screens, expand column size to full width on larger screens)
- clip story descriptions so stories with very long descriptions don't take up too much board space (clip story cards to a maximum height).
- Remove "unrecognized status" box at the bottom (enforced via cli tool)
- "Updated" clock ticker seems to only refresh every 2 seconds, update polling to 1s
- Clip columns to the window height and implement vertical scrolling within columns, so that one column with tons of stories (e.g. Backlog or Done) doesn't make page scrolling a chore
